caption: The drawing depicts an object resembling a geometric, angular shape composed of straight and slightly curved edges. The object is colored in a light brown, rusty hue and appears metallic in texture. It consists of a wide rectangular base with two short, thick legs extending downward, a narrower upright section rising vertically from the center of the base, and a rectangular cut-out near the top of the upright. Attached to the right side of the base is a long, angular arm that extends backward and outward at an upward angle, terminating in another short vertical segment. The composition is set against a plain, off-white background, with the object positioned slightly left of center and no additional objects or features present. The drawing uses subtle shading to suggest volume and a three-dimensional form.
title: Andiron or Fire Dog
